cohort: The study included 120 women equally divided into three groups based on maternal age: >=40 years, 20-29 years, and 30-39 years, all from a tertiary care center.
finding: Women aged >=40 years had significantly higher rates of gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders, cesarean sections, and NICU admissions, with lower neonatal birthweights.
mod_finding: Women aged >=40 years exhibited significantly higher rates of cesarean sections.
birth_weight: Lower neonatal birthweights in the advanced maternal age group.
